method: SEC filing index and its observed primary_doc.html link opened in normal browser; rendered Part A/B/E read from document.body.innerText. Decimal strings normalized only for sign/leading/trailing zeros and compared as strings, never floating point. Original NAV fields below copied from tool output and rechecked with Fraction. Notes matched by whitespace-normalized text and count. 40 final records had all field checks true. Some incomplete renders were retried after navigation/load; they were not treated as source mismatches.
preservation_limit: Browser comparison log and original NAV values are preserved; complete original XML/HTML files were not downloaded. Bulk raw values remain in the SHA256-identified archive. Re-reading originals requires public access.
sampling: First20 lexicographic and top20 plus ties on the provisional exact-NAV subset, no overlap. If quarantines later change eligibility, regenerate both sets; this is not a final audit selection for a changed sample.
